name: 91020 · Montrose, CA
findings: ZIP 91020 (Montrose) has 44 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91020 (Montrose) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 91020 (Montrose) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.
